story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date
Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date
Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes preserves relevant field values
Future eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date
Regression confirms Maintenance Date is not used outside specified condition and finance impact remains stable
Multiple inbound date occurrences use the first date received
